Mark Dubowitz (@mdubowitz)

Ali Khamenei is gone. Yahya Sinwar is gone. Hassan Nasrallah is gone.

We’ll see how Mojtaba Khamenei and Erdogan evolve. For now, Peter is out front. Mazal Tov.
